RULE-1.gloss: If WaterIn(o, w1) ∧ WaterIn(p, w2) ∧ Add(w1, w2, w3) then WaterIn(orange_and_pineapple_mixture, w3)
RULE-1.formula: ∀o∀p∀w1∀w2∀w3((WaterIn(o, w1) ∧ WaterIn(p, w2) ∧ Add(w1, w2, w3)) → WaterIn(orange_and_pineapple_mixture, w3))

RULE-3.formula: ∀w∀w_lost∀w_remain((WaterIn(orange_drink, w) ∧ WaterLostFromOrange(w_lost) ∧ Subtract(w, w_lost, w_remain)) → WaterInAfterSpill(orange_drink, w_remain))

RULE-4.gloss: If WaterInAfterSpill(orange_drink, w1) ∧ WaterIn(pineapple_drink, w2) ∧ Add(w1, w2, w3) then WaterInTotalAfterSpill(total_water_after_spill, w3)
